annotations.title: Draw a picture of the data

description: A picture of the data as image content plus what was drawn: an image plane (default channel 0, middle z), a composite, a max projection (mip=z), a region (only the tiles needed are read), a trace or spectrum plot (largest peaks labelled; marks=spikes marks action potentials; x_range zooms), a Sanger chromatogram with base calls and quality or a sized electropherogram with the ladder, a plate heat map or, for kinetic reads, per-well growth curves coloured by layout group, or a flow-cytometry density plot. Image pictures carry rulers in full-resolution pixels and a µm scale bar, so a region read off the rulers zooms in. annotations draw your own labelled points, boxes, outlines, arrows, lines and bands in the picture's coordinates, to show the user what you found. Draws only; openreadout_export saves the picture.

Annotation.description: One annotation, in the coordinates the picture shows: full-resolution pixels on images (as on the rulers), axis units on plots (as on the tick labels), and on plate curve grids the time and value axes every card shares.

channel.description: Trace previews with several panels: the channel whose panel it goes in (default: the first panel).

color.description: `accent` (default, warm red), `ink`, `muted`, `white`, another colour name or `#RRGGBB`.

facet.description: Plots with small multiples: the one small plot it goes in, by its title (e.g. `B3` or `sweep 6`; default: every one).

label.description: Text drawn with the mark (the text itself for type text).

type.description: What to draw. `point` = a dot at x, y (with its label beside it); `box` = a rectangle: corner x, y and width, height; `polygon` = a closed outline through points; `line` = an open line through points; `arrow` = an arrow from x, y (where the label goes) to x2, y2; `text` = the label alone, at x, y; `vline` = a vertical line at x; `hline` = a horizontal line at y; `vband` = a vertical band from x to x2; `hband` = a horizontal band from y to y2; `well` = a ring around a plate well (well; previews of plates only).

well.description: Plate previews: the well (e.g. `B3`) for type well, or the one card a mark goes in on a curve grid (default: every card).

x.description: point, text: position; box: corner; arrow: tail; vline, vband: x (vband from x to x2).

y.description: point, text: position; box: corner; arrow: tail; hline, hband: y (hband from y to y2).

LadderRequest.description: The marker lane and its sizes.

lane.description: Lane number of the marker (1 = leftmost).

sizes.description: Marker sizes from the top of the lane down (largest first), e.g. kDa or bp.

unit.description: Unit of the sizes, e.g. `kDa` or `bp`.

LanesRequest.description: How lanes and bands are found. Everything is optional.

count.description: Number of lanes. Default: found from the image.

ladder.description: The marker lane and its sizes; bands then get sizes.

min_share.description: Bands lower than this share of the lane's highest band are dropped. Default 0.05.

polarity.description: Bright bands (fluorescence, chemiluminescence) or dark ones (stains). Default auto. `auto` = from the image: dark objects on a bright background (brightfield) or bright ones; `bright` = objects brighter than the background (fluorescence); `dark` = objects darker than the background (brightfield).

profiles.description: Return each lane's profile (200 values from the top down). Default false.

width_px.description: Lane width in pixels. Default 0.7 lane pitches.

ObjectsRequest.description: How objects are found. Everything is optional; the defaults suit nuclei.

diameter_px.description: The same in pixels, for images without a pixel size.

diameter_um.description: Expected object diameter in µm. Default: measured from the image (spots: 0.5 µm).

kind.description: Default nuclei. `nuclei` = nuclei (default): touching nuclei are split; `cells` = whole cells stained throughout (larger; touching cells are split); `spots` = small bright spots (puncta, foci, single molecules), found by a Laplacian of Gaussian.

max_area_um2.description: Largest object kept in µm². Default: no limit.

max_objects.description: Objects listed (in reading order). Default 100; the counts cover all.

method.description: Default auto. `auto` = Otsu's, or the triangle method when objects are sparse; `otsu` = Otsu's (two classes of similar spread); `triangle` = the triangle method (a big background peak, few objects); `local` = each pixel against its neighbourhood (uneven staining).

min_area_um2.description: Smallest object kept in µm². Default: a fifth of the expected area.

polarity.description: Default auto. `auto` = from the image: dark objects on a bright background (brightfield) or bright ones; `bright` = objects brighter than the background (fluorescence); `dark` = objects darker than the background (brightfield).

split.description: Cut touching objects apart (seeded watershed). Default true.

stain.description: RGB images. Default auto. `auto` = hematoxylin for brightfield (stained tissue); for fluorescence, blue for nuclei when the blue component holds signal, else the brightest component; `hematoxylin` = the nuclear stain of H&E and IHC, by colour deconvolution; `eosin` = eosin, by colour deconvolution; `dab` = the brown IHC chromogen, by colour deconvolution; `red` = one component; `green` = one component; `blue` = one component; `luminance` = the mean of the components.

threshold.description: Threshold in raw units of what is measured (spots: the height above the local background). Default: chosen by `method`.

Region.description: A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

x.description: Left edge (column of the first pixel).

y.description: Top edge (row of the first pixel).

annotations.description: Your own marks, drawn on top and reported back with their pixel positions. Coordinates as the picture shows them: full-resolution pixels on images (the ruler numbers), axis units on plots, wells on plates.

axes.description: Image previews: what frames the picture. `rulers` = coordinate rulers in full-resolution pixels and a scale bar around the picture (default); `grid` = rulers, plus faint grid lines over the data at the ruler ticks; `scale-bar` = a figure for people: the picture with a scale bar, the title and the caption; no rulers; `none` = the bare downsampled plane.

caption.description: Image previews with axes scale-bar: a caption under the picture (what it shows, the stain, the sample).

centroid.description: Spectrum preview: the instrument's centroid list instead of the profile.

channels.description: Trace preview: channel indices (default: the first 8).

columns.description: Table columns: a plate's value column, or the x and y parameters of a flow-cytometry density plot (one gives a histogram; default FSC-A, SSC-A).

composite.description: Blend all (or the selected) channels additively in their colours.

contrast.description: `auto` (default; the file's display window when it has one, `log:90,99.95` on diffraction images), `min-max`, `percentile:LO,HI` (e.g. `percentile:1,99`), `log` (`log:50,99.9`) or `log:LO,HI`, `raw`, or a display window `window:CENTER,WIDTH` (`window:40,400`), `window:file`, or a CT preset `window:soft-tissue`, `brain`, `subdural`, `stroke`, `bone`, `lung`, `mediastinum`, `liver`.

fft.description: Images: a power-spectrum (FFT) inset in the top-right corner: Thon rings of a cryo-EM micrograph, the spots of a lattice.

format.description: Encoding. Default png (sent as JPEG when a PNG would be too large); svg also returns the vector drawing as text. `png` = lossless (default); `jpeg` = lossy and smaller; `svg` = vector: text stays text, image data is embedded as PNG.

lanes.description: Gels and blots: how lanes are found for `marks: lanes` (as `openreadout_stats` lanes).

level.description: Pyramid level to read (default: the level nearest max_size, or the level at which `region` renders at about max_size).

lut.description: Colour lookup. Default: gray for one channel (inverted on diffraction images), channel colours for composites. `gray` = black to white; `channel-color` = black to the channel's colour; `inverted` = white to black: dark marks on a light ground (diffraction images).

marks.description: Marks from the data. Default auto: the prominent peaks of spectra and chromatograms are labelled; diffraction images get resolution rings. `auto` = label the largest peaks of spectra and chromatograms (default); `peaks` = label the largest peaks of any trace; `spikes` = mark the action potentials of current-clamp sweeps; `objects` = images: outline and number the nuclei, cells or spots found (`stats` objects); `lanes` = gels and blots: box and number the lanes, draw their profiles and bands (`stats` lanes); `rings` = diffraction images: resolution rings and the beam centre (auto draws them when the geometry is known); `none` = no marks.

max_size.description: Longest side in pixels, rulers included (MCP: default 768, at most 2048).

mip.description: Maximum-intensity projection, over the selected range if any. `z` = along z (focal planes); `t` = along t (time points).

objects.description: Images: how objects are found for `marks: objects` (as `openreadout_stats` objects).

region.description: Zoom: only this rectangle, `{x, y, width, height}` in full-resolution pixels (or in the pixels of `level` when a level is given). Whole-slide images: look at the overview first, then at regions of it.

scan.description: Spectrum preview: instrument scan number instead of an index.

select.description: Plane selection such as `c=1`, `z=4`, `t=0` or combined `c=0,1,z=2`. Default: c=0, the middle z, t=0. Several channels imply a composite.

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

sum.description: Sum projection, over the selected range if any: a movie's frames added up (e.g. sum t, select t=0-39). `z` = along z (focal planes); `t` = along t (time points).

table.description: Plate or flow-cytometry preview: table index.

title.description: Image previews with axes scale-bar: a title above the picture.

trace.description: Trace preview: trace index (see openreadout_info traces[]).

view.description: Volumes: the plane to show. `axial`, `coronal`, `sagittal` (radiological orientation), `orthogonal` (all three, crossing at the middle or the selected z), `xz`, `yz`, or `native` (as stored). Default: medical images in their acquisition plane, others native. With a view, `z` and `mip: z` count slices of that view. `native` = the planes as stored; `axial` = head-foot slices, patient's left on the right, anterior up; `coronal` = front-back slices, patient's left on the right, head up; `sagittal` = left-right slices, anterior on the left, head up; `orthogonal` = axial, coronal and sagittal planes through the volume's centre (or the selected z); `xz` = columns against z: a cut along the stack; `yz` = rows against z: a cut along the stack.

x_range.description: Trace preview: only this window of the x axis, `[a, b]` in its units (bp of a sized electropherogram, base positions of a Sanger read, minutes, ppm, …).

name: openreadout_preview

oneOf.description: a dot at x, y (with its label beside it)
a rectangle: corner x, y and width, height
an arrow from x, y (where the label goes) to x2, y2
the label alone, at x, y
a vertical band from x to x2
a horizontal band from y to y2
a ring around a plate well (well; previews of plates only)

ChromatogramPreview.description: Details of a chromatogram preview of a mass-spectrometry run (its first look).

apex_rt_min.description: Retention time of the tallest point, minutes.

scans.description: Scans in the run (all MS levels).

signal.description: `tic` (the total ion current each scan header records) or `bpc` (base-peak intensity).

DataMark.description: A mark drawn from the data: a labelled peak or a detected action potential.

kind.description:
`peak`, `spike`, `resolution_ring` (x: resolution in Å, y: radius in full-resolution
pixels) or `beam_center` (x, y: full-resolution pixels).

label.description: The label drawn (e.g. the m/z or ppm), if any.

x.description: Position along the x axis, in its unit.

y.description: Value there, in the panel's unit.

DrawnAnnotation.description: An annotation as drawn: the request, plus where it landed in PNG pixels.

channel.description:
Trace previews with several panels: the channel whose panel it goes in (default: the
first panel).

color.description: `accent` (default, warm red), `ink`, `muted`, `white`, another colour name or `#RRGGBB`.

facet.description:
Plots with small multiples: the one small plot it goes in, by its title (e.g. `B3` or
`sweep 6`; default: every one).

label.description: Text drawn with the mark (the text itself for type text).

label_px.description: Where the label went, in PNG pixels.

outside.description: True when part of the mark lies outside what the picture shows (it is clipped).

px.description:
The mark's key points in PNG pixels: the point, the box corners, the vertices, the
arrow's tail and head, a line's or band's ends (one pair per card on a curve grid).

well.description:
Plate previews: the well (e.g. `B3`) for type well, or the one card a mark goes in on a
curve grid (default: every card).

x.description: point, text: position; box: corner; arrow: tail; vline, vband: x (vband from x to x2).

y.description: point, text: position; box: corner; arrow: tail; hline, hband: y (hband from y to y2).

EventsPreview.description: Details of an event (flow cytometry) preview.

y.description: Parameter on the y axis (absent for a histogram).

ImagePreview.description:
Details of an image preview.

PNG pixel `(px, py)` inside `plot_area` shows full-resolution source pixel
`x = source_origin.x + (px - plot_area.x) * source_per_pixel`,
`y = source_origin.y + (py - plot_area.y) * source_per_pixel_y` (left/top edges of the PNG
pixel), whatever pyramid level, downsample or region was drawn; the ruler labels use the same
numbers, so a `region` read off them can be passed straight back.

axes.description:
True when the picture is framed by coordinate rulers (labelled in full-resolution
pixels), with a scale bar when the pixel size is known.

c.description: Channels, z-planes and time points used.

composite.description: True when channels were blended into one colour image.

contrast.description: Contrast rule applied (`auto` resolved to what it did, e.g. `percentile:0.1,99.9`).

crosshair.description: Orthogonal views: the voxel (x, y, z of the stored planes) the three planes cross at.

downsample.description:
Pixels of the plane at `level` per drawn pixel, horizontally: above 1 when the plane was
made smaller (an area average), below 1 when it was enlarged (each source pixel drawn as
a square), 1 when drawn as is.

fft_inset.description: Where the power-spectrum inset is drawn (`fft`), in PNG pixels.

full_res_region.description:
The full-resolution (level 0) rectangle the plot area shows: pass it, or a part of it,
back as `region` to zoom.

grid.description: True when grid lines were drawn over the data at the ruler ticks.

plot_area.description: The data's rectangle inside the PNG, in PNG pixels (the whole PNG without rulers).

projection.description: `max-z` or `max-t` for a maximum-intensity projection, `sum-z` or `sum-t` for a sum.

region.description: The rectangle drawn, in the pixel coordinates of `level`, when a region was asked for.

rgb.description: True when the planes are RGB (samples_per_pixel 3).

scale_bar.description: The scale bar drawn, when the physical pixel size is known.

source_origin.description: Full-resolution source coordinate of the plot area's top-left corner.

source_per_pixel.description:
Full-resolution source pixels per PNG pixel, horizontally (pyramid level scale ×
`downsample`).

source_per_pixel_y.description:
Full-resolution source pixels per PNG pixel, vertically (equal to `source_per_pixel` up
to the rounding of pyramid level sizes).

view.description:
The plane of the volume shown, when it is not the stored planes: `axial`, `coronal`,
`sagittal`, `orthogonal`, `xz` or `yz`. Rulers, regions and annotations then count the
pixels of that view.

view_slices.description: With a view: how many slices it has (the range of `z`).

PlateGroup.description: One layout group of a plate preview (a SoftMax Pro group, a sample name, …).

name.description: Group name as the file records it.

grouped_by.description: The layout field the colours follow (e.g. `SoftMax group`).

groups.description: The groups, in the order of the key.

layout.description: `wide` (one column per well) or `long` (`well` or `row` + `column` columns).

max.description: Heat map: value at the dark end of the colour scale; curves: top of every card's y axis.

min.description:
Heat map: value at the light end of the colour scale; curves: bottom of every card's y
axis.

time.description: Curves: the time axis every card shares, in `time_unit`.

value.description: What each cell shows (a column name, or `mean of N rows`).

view.description: `heatmap` (one value per well) or `curves` (a kinetic read, one small plot per well).

PlotPanel.description:
One plot panel inside the picture, for mapping PNG pixels to data values and back: the
value at the panel's left edge is `x[0]`, at its right edge `x[1]`, at its bottom `y[0]`
and at its top `y[1]`, along the scale named in `x_scale` / `y_scale`.

channel.description: Trace previews: the channel drawn in this panel.

plot_area.description: The panel's rectangle in PNG pixels.

well.description: Plate curve previews: the well of this card.

x.description: Values at the left and right edges.

y.description: Values at the bottom and top edges.

PreviewChannel.description: One channel of an image preview.

color.description: Display colour `#RRGGBB` (`#FFFFFF` with the gray LUT).

color_source.description: Where the colour came from: `file` (`channels[].color`), `wavelength`, `palette` or `lut`.

display_max.description: Sample value shown at full brightness.

Region.description: A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

x.description: Left edge (column of the first pixel).

y.description: Top edge (row of the first pixel).

ScaleBar.description: The scale bar drawn under an image preview.

SourcePoint.description: A point in full-resolution (level 0) source pixel coordinates.

x.description: Column (may be fractional on a downsampled pyramid level).

ms_level.description: MS level (1 = full scan, 2 = fragment scan, ...).

precursor_mz.description: Precursor m/z of a fragment (MS2+) scan.

rt_s.description: Retention time in seconds; null when the file states none.

scan_number.description: Scan number as the instrument counts it.

x_axis.description: m/z range of the x axis.

channels.description: One panel per channel, top to bottom (one shared panel for overlays).

sample_count.description: Samples drawn (from the start of the sweep).

truncated.description: True when the sweep is longer than the samples drawn.

x_axis.description: Label of the horizontal axis, when known.

TracePreviewChannel.description: One channel of a trace preview.

max.description: Top of the panel's y axis.

min.description: Bottom of the panel's y axis.

XAxis.description: The horizontal axis of a trace or spectrum preview.

last.description: Value at the right edge (smaller than `first` for NMR chemical shift, which runs right to left).

annotations.description: The caller's annotations as drawn: each as given, plus where it landed in PNG pixels.

chromatogram.description: Present for chromatogram previews (a mass-spectrometry run's total-ion chromatogram).

format.description: Format id of the input file.

hint.description: What to do next with the picture (look at it; zoom with a region read off the rulers).

lanes.description: `marks: lanes`: the lanes and bands found in the area shown, as `stats` lanes.

marks.description: Marks drawn from the data (labelled peaks, action potentials).

notes.description: Anything the caller should know (fallbacks, caps, implied options).

objects.description:
`marks: objects`: the objects counted in the area shown, as `stats` objects (the first
20 listed).

output.description: The written file (CLI); absent when the preview is returned inline (MCP image content).

panels.description:
Plot panels (traces, spectra, plate curves, events): where each sits in the picture and
the data range it shows.

save.description: How to save this picture to a file (MCP: the openreadout_export call).

verified.description: True once a written file was read back and matched.

xxh3.description: xxh3-128 of the encoded bytes, 32 hex chars (identical across runs for the same request).
